responsibility: Holds reviewable candidate facts and declarations. JSONL/YAML is preferred; Python source-model literals are transitional authoring, not runtime truth.
Executes the declared package DAG, checks immutable snapshots versus live projections, and proves clean-build equivalence.
Purely projects declared inputs into normalized deterministic artifacts and manifests.
May access external sources and emit immutable, provenance-bound raw snapshots; it never writes canonical semantic decisions.
Executes exact oracles or reference implementations in a finite declared environment and retains occurrence-scoped receipts.
Tests compiler, planner, binder or reconciliation semantics against fixtures; it is not a qualified production implementation.
May implement an exact contract for conformance and portability campaigns, but remains separate from the corpus and from provider qualification.
Builds reverse indexes, support sets, corpus routes and gap/work queues; indexes never become semantic authority.
Checks schemas, identities, references, invariants, negative twins, freshness and fail-closed gates without promoting authority.
